It was first released as part of the {{TCG|Black & White}} expansion. ==Card text== {{TCGTrainerText |class=Supporter |rule=Supporter |effect=Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. }} ==Release information== This card was first released in the {{TCG|Black & White}} expansion, originating from the {{TCG|Black Collection}} in Japan. In Japan, this card was reprinted as one of the {{TCG|BW-P Promotional cards}} in a ten card random pack released during the February 2011 Gym Challenge. It was later reprinted with new artwork by [[Kanako Eo]] in the {{TCG|Reshiram-EX Battle Strength Deck|Reshiram-EX}} and {{TCG|Zekrom-EX Battle Strength Deck}}s. This print was released in the English {{TCG|Dark Explorers}} expansion. The original print was later included in the {{TCG|Hydreigon Half Deck|Hydreigon}} and {{TCG|Garchomp Half Deck}}s, the {{TCG|Master Deck Build Box EX}}, the {{TCG|Black Kyurem-EX Battle Strength Deck|Black Kyurem-EX}} and {{TCG|White Kyurem-EX Battle Strength Deck}}, and the {{TCG|Blastoise + Kyurem-EX Combo Deck}}. It was then released as a {{TCG|Full Art card}} in the {{TCG|Plasma Freeze}} expansion, originating from the Japnese {{TCG|Thunder Knuckle}} expansion, with new artwork by [[Kanako Eo]]. The original Black & White artwork was reprinted again in the English {{TCG|Plasma Blast}} expansion. Special Crosshatch Holofoil versions of the Black & White and Dark Explorers prints were made available to members of the Professor Program during the 2012-2013 {{TCG|Pokémon League}} Cycle. ===Gallery=== {{TCGGallery |type=Supporter |image1=ProfessorJuniperBlackWhite101.jpg |set1=Black & White |illus1=Ken Sugimori |image2=ProfessorJuniperDarkExplorers98.jpg |set2=Dark Explorers |illus2=Kanako Eo |image3=ProfessorJuniperPlasmaFreeze116.jpg |set3=Plasma Freeze |illus3=Kanako Eo }} ==Rulings== This card's effect is identical to {{TCG ID|XY|Professor Sycamore|122}}. Because of this, {{TCG|errata}} was issued for both cards stating that only one or the other be included in the same [[deck]], not both. This ruling later included {{TCG ID|Sword & Shield|Professor's Research|178}}. ==Trivia== This card's effect is that of {{TCG ID|Base Set|Professor Oak|88}} as a Supporter card. ===Origin=== [[Professor Juniper]] is the resident [[Pokémon Professor]] of the [[Unova]] region. {{DL|Nuvema Town|Professor Juniper's lab}} is featured in the Regular print illustrations. {{Project TCG notice}} [[Category:Professor Juniper (TCG)]] [[Category:Black & White cards]] [[Category:Black Collection cards]] [[Category:BW-P Promotional cards]] [[Category:Dark Explorers cards]] [[Category:Reshiram-EX Battle Strength Deck cards]] [[Category:Zekrom-EX Battle Strength Deck cards]] [[Category:Hydreigon Half Deck cards]] [[Category:Garchomp Half Deck cards]] [[Category:Master Deck Build Box EX cards]] [[Category:Black Kyurem-EX Battle Strength Deck cards]] [[Category:White Kyurem-EX Battle Strength Deck cards]] [[Category:Plasma Freeze cards]] [[Category:Thunder Knuckle cards]] [[Category:Plasma Blast cards]] [[Category:Blastoise + Kyurem-EX Combo Deck cards]] [[Category:Illus. by Ken Sugimori]] [[Category:Illus. by Kanako Eo]] [[Category:Holographic cards]] [[Category:Secret cards]] [[Category:Full Art cards]] [[Category:Trainer cards with discard costs]] [[Category:Trainer cards that draw cards from player's deck]] [[Category:Cards with errata]] [[de:Prof. Esche (TCG)]] [[es:Prof.ª Encina (TCG)]] [[fr:Professeur Keteleeria (Noir & Blanc 101)]] [[it:Prof.ssa Aralia (Nero e Bianco 101)]] [[ja:アララギ博士 (カードゲーム)]] [[zh:红豆杉博士（TCG）]]
